reviews.text: Thank you, Amy, for the 5 star review!
Thank you!

Dr. Stephanie Cerovsky handles my dog, Zooey, with the outmost medical expertise and care. Dr. Cerovsky goes above and beyond to provide sound medical advice and also weigh in on Zooey comfort at home as Zooey battles a disfunction of her hind legs. Dr. Cerovsky is the most attentive and caring doctor I met so far.

We found Oak Forest after losing our beloved doctor, and I’m so thankful we did. It’s close to our home and an incredibly well-organized practice. I had hoped to find one doctor for all our pets, but after seeing multiple doctors here, we love every single one of them — so now we just book with whoever is available!

It’s an all-female practice, which I love as a fellow female business owner. I truly can’t say enough good things about this place. The prices are fair, the service is exceptional, and the love and care our babies receive is second to none. Oak Forest is simply wonderful.

We live in Oak Forest and love the techs and vets at Oak Forest Vet. I just dropped off our six year old German Shepherd for a bath and nail trim and they did a fantastic job. I just can't say enough about everyone there.
Thank you!

Reasonably easy to get appointments, staff and technicians are friendly and caring. My dog and I have always seen Dr. Codi Cass and she is wonderful - sensible, kind, friendly, down to earth, knowledgeable, competent.  Two thumbs up to OFV!

Followed Dr. Cerovsky here from WAAC, been loving it so far! The staff here are friendly and relatively thorough, the facilities are clean and my dog is well taken care of every time she comes here. Also, really appreciate the free water/tea/coffee/hot chocolate in the waiting room :)
We were helped very quickly and the whole appointment only took about 40 minutes. Great job!

Dr. Stephanie Cerovsky is awesome.  I can tell she really cares for her patients. Shes very informative and answers all my questions. Im happy to have her as my dogs vet. The techs and receptionist staff are always nice as well.

My dogs have been going to this clinic for four years. I’ve always been happy with this office. The doctors and staff are knowledgeable and thorough. In addition, everyone is pleasant to deal with. I would highly recommend this veterinary clinic for your pets.

We had a wonderful experience with the vet and staff while caring for our dog, Harper. Everyone was kind, compassionate, and genuinely cared about her well-being. They took the time to explain everything clearly and made us feel confident that Harper was in great hands. We’re very grateful for the care she received!
Our vet is Dr. Crocker. She is wonderful with my pups as well as the vet techs. I have used other vets there too when Dr. Crocker is unavailable and all were great as well. Wouldn’t go anywhere else.
Quick, easy, affordable. This was an annual checkup with vaccines.
Very complete review. Didn’t get what I wanted to hear but I got the truth. Hoping I can continue to do the right things.
We love OFV! They take wonderful care of our beloved pet, especially through some tricky diagnoses. Have recommended this vet to many friends and will continue to do so.

I have two very "special" Frenchies and Dr. Krystin Schaack has been their doctor for years.  She is so patient with them and with me.  I tend to get very emotional/nervous and ask a ton of questions and she is truly wonderful.  One of my Frenchies has a history of Cancer, IVDD and extreme anxiety and she's been so helpful in all aspects of his care. We love Dr. Schaack.
Great vet,been going for about 20 years are so.wonderful staff and very friendly ,my dogs favorite place.

We've been bringing Maisie to Oak Forest Veterinary Hospital since we got her in May 2020, and our experience has been wonderful with both boarding and veterinary services. When we go away and don't have a friend for her to stay with, she boards here, and they are so sweet to her. They love on her in a way that makes me feel genuinely good about leaving her there. At pickup, the boarding staff was giving her hugs and kisses goodbye. They also gave her a great goodbye bath, plus nails, anal glands, teeth, all of it. The front desk is so nice, and I love that many of the same people are still there from 2020. We wouldn't take her anywhere else.

We roughy our new Bernedoodle puppy, Augustus, to Oak Forest Veterinary Hospital for his first check-up. From the moment we walked in, the staff was so welcoming and kind the new puppy; everyone wanted to say hello! We arrived time and did not have to wait. the exam was quick and thorough. my dog and I were both so happy with the whole experience, and I'd definitely recommend this Vet Clinic to any friends and family with a new puppy or an old dog.

I have been taking my senior dog to Oak Forest Veterinary Hospital for three years and am always impressed with the care the staff provides. My dog sees Dr. Lane, and she always provides facts to help you make the best decision for your pet’s health. My dog has gone to Oak Forest for teeth cleaning/extractions, nail trimming, blood work, kidney issues, and now arthritis pain, and Dr. Lane has walked me through all of it. The vet techs who have helped my dog have been so kind and gentle with my dog, and I never worry about the care he is getting. They are the only ones who are able to trim my dog’s nails! I recommend this vet to all of my friends!
Thank you!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I can't say enough good things about Oak Forest Veterinary Hospital! They've always provided exceptional care for my golden retriever, Copper, who is about to turn two. From her spay surgery to managing her allergy medications, flea treatments, and distemper shots, the team goes above and beyond to ensure she stays healthy and happy.

They also do a fantastic job with her nail trims, making the experience as stress-free as possible. The staff is always pleasant and welcoming, which makes each visit a joy. I truly appreciate everything they do for Copper and can't recommend them enough. Thank you, Oak Forest Veterinary Hospital, for being such a wonderful part of Coppers life !
Everyone at this facility treat both the animals and their owners so kindly. They are friendly and really care about our pets while providing excellent care. Highly recommend!
They have been taking care of dog for 11 years. Their service is always wonderful.

Dr. Lane is fantastic! She is so gentle and kind to our elderly 13 year old Labrador Rosie. She spent well over an hour and was able to check out a number of concerns we came with today. I always feel like she understands our worries and goals of having as healthy a senior dog as possible. Thank you, Dr. Lane, for caring for our Rosie! We appreciate your love and expertise!

Everyone is always nice and seems thorough.  Them do there best to get everyone in as well.

And our dog actually likes going there.

Very nice!
Thank you!
Thank you!

Doctor Lane and her vet tech Josaline were great with my elderly pup Theo. They were very thorough Examining him and even got down on the floor with him as he dislikes getting on the exam table. They were kind and gentle. Of course Theo enjoyed the treats. They gave him as well. I highly recommend this veterinary group. I have been going there for over 14 years with my Theo and my two cats I had previously.
Saved my dogs life.  Thank you.
Thank you Teresa.

Dr. Schaack and her assistant were so great with my dog who was not particularly thrilled to be at the vet. They met him where he was at and did the exam on the floor rather than the raised table which seemed to help calm him down. The exam went well and was over in no time. Everyone else was also very friendly and helpful during our visit. :)
Love this vet!

Always a great experience, the staff is warm and compassionate from the moment you walk through the door! The doctor doesn't rush me and let's me ask all the questions I need and responds in kind. Highly recommend!!
Boo Boo and I had a great visit! The staff is always loving on him. He eats it up! Thank you all for the wonderful care you give my fur babies!
Thank you!

As usual, it was awesome! I ❤❤❤❤❤❤ Oak Forest Animal Hospital.

#1- they know my dogs by name
#2- the clinic is absolutely gorgeous
#3- always here on any situation
#4-FANTASTIC Doctors
#- FANTASTIC staff

Please do not change in any way! OFVH(or clinic) as everything, and I mean everything is excellent!
Thank you!
Oak Forest Vet took such good care of our dog and we couldn’t have had a better experience!
Dr. Cerovsky and staff have been wonderful. They’ve been very thorough when assessing my pup. They were very timely with updates during his recent procedure. Highly recommend!
They take such good care of my puppy every time we go. I have never had to wait longer than 5 minutes and I appreciated how quickly they got us in to take care of her suspected UTI.
Very caring and thoughtful vet and boarding. They saved my dog's life and worked on a Sunday. I will always be grateful. Best vet in Houston!
We love Oak Forest Vets!
Very friendly and efficient Excellent !
Great vet, I have been coming here a few years now with my older dog and they are so amazing. They are very thorough, easy to get in for appointments and always helpful.

2 dogs and a cat. Very solid vet practice. Have been to a couple others in the area which were quite a bit more expensive - they have fair pricing. Very professional from setting the appointment to after care. Highly recommend

They are so kind and compassionate with our cats. We've had a lot of different health issues but they have always been there to take care of them. I wouldn't go anywhere else. From the team at the front desk to the text in the back and the doctors they are at the top of their game!
Thank you!
Thank you Chris.
Dr Moore and her team are fabulous. From the receptionists greeting to the exam room tech everyone is friendly and helpful. 5 stars!!!

My Catahoula Leopard mix was completely unable to walk on a slippery surface, but his wonderful doctor got him on Ataquan, which has been a miracle drug for him. Now he can walk on tile or polished concrete without having to be held up, and he’s enjoying his walks. The fantastic staff are always very kind and patient with his old man issues.

Dr. Lane and the staff at Oak Foest Veterinary Hospital are awesome! Dr. Lane has been our Beagles' doctor since Snoopdogg was around 4 months old. Dr. Lane has exceptional bedside manner and every staff member we've encountered here has treated both our pets with love and care. I highly recommend bringing your family member here if you are looking for quality,  trusted care.

This is a great place with excellent professionals. They took very good care of my cat, explained thoroughly the issues and the options, and helped me to make the best decision for her. Highly recommended.
I’ve been coming to Oak Forest Veterinary Hospital for 12 years. Dr. Crocker and the rest of the staff are great. Even though my dogs are not fans of vet visits, they are healthy and happy.

When I got my third dog, I knew I would need to board her rather than get local dogsitters since my trips out of town would be more of a “last minute” need due to a family situation.

So while my other two dogs had always gone to Oak Forest Veterinary for medical needs, this one goes for dayboard and longtime board as well as medical.

And she loves it there.  I always feel good about her medical needs being met.  But she walks in there like the queen, walks up to the counter, and puts her paws on it to let them know she is there.  She is convinced everyone there is in place for her alone.

My other dogs were fine going to the doctor there. Rylie thinks she gets the privilege of spending the day…oh, and sometimes we slip a dr, appointment in there.

But the point is that it’s the best feeling to have a dog that wants to go to the vet’s because everyone is so nice and friendly to her there.

We are big fans of Oak Forest Veterinary Hospital!

The yellow lab is Murphy having a procedure in his day. The black&white is Rylie at dayboard.
Dr. Lane and the staff are amazing! I'm in all the time with my dogs and my fosters. Dr. Lane always has a plan regardless of the issue.

So very professional from the time you call for an appointment, the exam/procedure & checkout.
They love your pet children just like you do.
Professional and personalable.
Oak Forest Vets are wonderful and take great care of my fur babies.
Long-standing neighborhood veterinary clinic. Oak Forest Veterinary Hospital. I have used them for 60 years. They’re still a very trust worthy and reliable service

It started with my eldest dog Mama Chula. Not eating and throwing up and bloody diarrhea then straight blood pooping. Then her sons Elvis and Junior started same symptoms. We thought we were going to lose all 3 of our babies but Dr Stephanie helped us narrow it down. She took all kinds of tests and extays of Chula and finally we figured out it was food poisoning from their normal diet. She saved our babies lives and her staff. I couldn't be more grateful and appreciative to them more than I can say. They're true Angel's
Great place.  On time appointment and very through.

My 12 year old girl has been slowing down the last few months, with obvious discomfort. Dr. Stephanie Cerovsky took the time to listen, do a thorough exam, and provide several options for pain management and osteoarthritis control. She gave a full write-up of our discussion in the receipt, and then followed up the next day to see if I have questions. I'm confident that I've found a "partner" to manage my aging dog's issues!

Pricing was fantastic as well, I actually said, "are you sure that's it??" at the check-out process.

Give Oak Forest Veterinary Hospital a try. Independent vet clinics are hard to find!
Thank you.

Oak Forest Veterinary Hospital has been just awesome. Our 11yo dog was diagnosed with diabetes and has been a frequent flier for a variety of different ailments since the beginning of this year. The staff here are friendly and attentive, but most importantly the quality of care exceeds our expectations. We are so appreciative of all of the staff and their efforts. Dr. Schaack is awesome.

We have generally had decent experiences here, but our recent post-surgery experience with our dog was frustrating.

After a $1,600+ procedure, the bandage over his stitches fell off within hours, even though our pup was still groggy from anesthesia and just laying around at home.

We brought him back the next day to be re-bandaged while we handled childcare and school obligations, but were told he would need to wait several hours — over four hours — just to have a new bandage applied.

What made the experience even more frustrating is that we are now being charged for the replacement bandage. We called and asked that the charge be removed, given that the original bandage failed almost immediately after the procedure, but management refused.

I do not expect perfection, but this felt like poor treatment and nickel-and-diming after an expensive procedure, rather than the kind of post-operative support I would expect.
Very clean and the staff were very efficient. The Dr. Who saw my dog was extremely informative and my dog(who is usually wary of strangers and strange surroundings was very relaxed.
Thank you!

Update(6/24/26):  Dr Moore is rarely available, the front is quite unhelpful and rude(except a couple) and the care has gone up in price and down in quality, from my experience.  I was hoping to keep them as a secondary option, but no..... Do not recommend.

Dr. Moore is really good.  Unfortunately that is about it.  Unfortunately she is difficult to book and therefore it is time to move on.  I have had several issues with other visits not with Dr. Moore.

Dr. Crocker has been our vet for a number of years. For each of my dogs she has always been thorough, conservative in approach regarding treatment (Cushings for one dog/Lymphoma for another dog), kind and takes her time to answer questions. The front desk staff and the vet techs are always friendly, kind and respond quickly to inquiries. Several of our dogs have had to be assisted to cross the rainbow bridge and the entire staff have always been so considerate and respectful of our feelings. We have received a card from them with their kind notes and signatures, which means a lot when you're grieving.
The people here are wonderful.  They have the best vets, techs and front desk people. They are professional and courteous.
The vets and the staff are wonderful! The facility is also immaculate.
Thank you
The staff are very helpful and caring for my fur babies. They explain each step along.

Seems to me that the new vet there isn’t well qualified and randomly suggests unnecessary tests only to tell you that the issue is just behavioral.  I am disappointed because after 15years of being a patron I can no longer trust the people they hire to give vet services.  It’s seems to me that they have a quota to reach and indiscriminately suggest test due to their limited experience in diagnosing.  Very unhappy and sad that I trusted them with my dogs and now I only feel taken advantage of.  Please go elsewhere but here.
Love this place.  The staff is so thorough and friendly.
Semi annual visit
Dr. Lane is the best always !

I truly appreciate the entire staff for their hard work. I know us pet parents can be difficult at times 😅 but their professionalism is through the roof. Special thank you for Dr. Crocker, Dr. Cerosky, and all the techs including Kate. …
Attentive and friendly service.
Great vets that care about your pets like they are their own!!!

Front desk was friendly and helpful. Vet assistant was very caring and helpful too. Dr. Moore was kind, compassionate and very knowledgeable with treatment to help our elderly dog live much longer. We’ve gone to Oak Forest vet since the 80’s and have always been pleased with everything.
Dr Moore is the absolute best! Professional, thorough and communicates in plain language. Vet techs and staff are helpful, friendly.
Staff are very friendly
Thank you!
In & out in about 45 minutes so that was excellent! Also really enjoyed our vet Dr. Stephanie

One of the vets at this clinic shared how she didn't brush their dog's teeth because the dog didn't like it. As such, we stopped brushing our dog's teeth as much as we thought we should because we have the same problem. Now, the same clinic wants at a minimum $620 for a one time cleaning.

My English Lab, Twain, is a new patient. I was not able to take Twain in for his annual, but my trainer was. The service was exceptional. The vet called me and was very informative.  I am very glad that I made the switch over to Oak Forest Vet Hosp.
They are timely, professional, personal, and love my dog! What more could you ask for?
The staff at Oak Forest Vet Hospital are wonderful to work with, they have procedures to assist with managing reactive pets and always give us great care and attention.

Very loving vets and incredible staff!  Everyone there is a pleasure to deal with and my babies are so well treated.  Dr Hallie Ray Moore has been my vet for more years than she or I want to admit. She is the best!  She loves animals and people and it shows.

I’ve been to a few Veterinary Clinics in Houston and Oak Forest is above and beyond the others. Their staff is the best and you immediately know that they love their job and the animals!! I feel so comfortable with them treating my fur babies!!
Thank you.

After x-rays, Dr. Moore failed to mention our pet had previously suffered a shotgun blast and had over 20 pellets still in her. When we complained and asked for a referral to TAMU, she fired us as patients while we still had an active appointment booked. OFVH failed to help in any way. Failing to be able to interpret and relay x-ray results to an owner is bad enough; patient abandonment is just a whole other level of scummy behavior.

EDIT: Look at the boiler-plate response and recognize the apathy. Like any other business, they mess up a few times. It’s how they respond to those times that define them.

As always my dog loves going to see everyone at Oak Forest Vet's office - service and care is wonderful! Been a client since the early 80s with all pets through out the years! He loves staying there when needed

We love Oak Forest! They always treat our fur babies as one of their family. We do not live near oak forest anymore but we travel to see them for the care of our pets. It is important to have doctors you can trust and to ensure the health of your babies is paramount. That is what Oak Forest provides.

OFVH is just so great. My pets always receive great care and attention from the veterinarians and staff here. The communication is excellent and they have incredible availability for appointment times. Additionally, the prices for their services are very reasonable, especially as costs for nearly everything have risen dramatically in the past few years.  10/10.

My dogs have been patients at OFV since around 2009 and I have always felt they receive outstanding care. We have been through it all - puppies, surgeries, illness, chronic conditions, emergencies, and end of life. The staff is warm and caring and the vets themselves so obviously love the animals they care for. I can’t imagine using anyone else. Oh- and although in the beginning it was all Dr. Moore (and we still adore her), I don’t hesitate to have my dogs looked at by any of the other providers. They are great at continuity between each other.

OFVH provides great care for my dog.  I have been taking him there for the past five years, and always have a very nice experience, as does my dog as well.
Dr. Schaack and her staff are wonderful!  Thank you.
The staff and doctors are all amazing here!

Dr. Lane and staff are amazing! From normal check-ups to now helping with my senior German Shepard's health issues. I've had am emergency before and I was able to be seen the same day. Dr. Lane has never rushed my appointment, and has stayed to answer all my questions.
Oak Forest Vet is always helpful and kind. Their prices are reasonable and very transparent.  My animals thrive in their care ❤️

When it came time to put our sweet Poseidon down, the employees at Oak Forest were so kind and considerate during our grieving process. We will never forget their empathy and compassion. They now treat our new rescue dog, Thor, and we have the utmost confidence in their ability to care for him. Thank you everyone at Oak Forest, you all are the best.
Thank you!
Thank you.

My partners dogs loves boarding here all the time, the kennel staff are amazing and I love getting updates on all of them. They are always so friendly and love saying updating us if anything is needed. We will be coming back here in the summer once my partner and I go on vacation. They definitely need more recognition
We love Oak Forest Vet and would trust our dog with anyone else. All of the doctors are knowledgeable and personable.
Thank you.

The best primary vet in town! Oak Forest Vet has taken care of my pup for 4+ years. They are kind, patient, and understanding. They make my pup feel so loved - HE LOVES GOING TO THE VET (believe it or not, it's a treat for him!). They have great customer service, they are good about getting you in for appointments, and they always call you to followup and see how your pet is doing. I will take all of my animals here for as long as I'm living in Houston!
Very friendly staff and kind veterinarians. My dogs get very nervous going to their appointments but their staff puts my dogs at ease.
Thank you.

Dr. Moore and the entire staff are wonderful.  Dr. Moore has cared for my 2 sets of boxers for about 14 years.  The dogs immediately fall in love w/ Dr. Moore and all her staff.  Me?  I'm a little harder to impress because I AM "THAT mother"   I am proud to report that I am very impressed and only Oak Forest will be trusted to care for my fur babies - GREAT JOB AND WE APPRECIATE EVERYONE!

10-6-25 - I am now up to three generations of boxers.  Dr. Moore & Dr. Crocker have set the bar so high and let me tell you that others fail miserably when trying to compete.  My 9 month old boxers recently were diagnosed with pneumonia after being boarded at a daycare facility.  Dr. Moore always is available (even on weekends) to offer help & guidance.  I texted with her while at an emergency vet.  Dr. Crocker moved her schedule to ensure we got in 1st thing the following Mon.  I am happy to report that the pups are fine now, and I credit all to Dr. Moore & Dr. Crocker's love, support and care of them.  Everyone at Oak Forest Vet Hospital is awesome and we love them so much.  THANK YOU!

Dr. Moore and Dr. Crocker continue to amaze and excel in the care provided to my boxers.  They go above and beyond as does there staff.  I am thankful for them before and after each appointment.  Thank you for always being there
Dr. Crocker and the staff take wonderful care of their patients. They are all kind and caring. Highly recommend
Thank you.
We have  been going to Oak Forest for over 10 years.  They are always very friendly and helpful.  The vets are knowledgeable and answer any questions you may have.
My senior dog, Pepper, had his teeth cleaned by Dr Cass yesterday and everything went well.  I was very worried about anesthesia because he has a heart murmur but the doctor took great care of him.

We LOVE  Dr. Crocker & her team!  She’s always addressed our questions & concerns promptly & always with professionalism. This visit we had a new foster puppy in the home 🏡 and really counted on her for a full exam and advise us on his age, breed, approximately how big he’ll get etc.   Thanks Dr. Crocker and your entire team . You all work so well together like a well oiled machine.  You’ve earned our business for life!
Thank you

Dr. Lane, Annie and all the staff at Oak Forest are absolutely amazing! I fully trust them to take care of my dog Maple May and can feel the compassion that they have for me and my girl! My shy rescue dogs loves to go to the vet here, so that says something. Would recommend and have many times to friends and family looking for wonderful quality vet medicine!
Staff is very professional and friendly. Amazing place to take my dogs.
We took our dog in on a Friday. They were absolutely packed! There was barely anywhere to sit. But they still treated us with the time and care that made us feel important.

We’ve been taking our dog, Gentry, to Oak Forest Veterinary Hospital since he was just 8 weeks old, and now at almost 7 years old, I can confidently say they have been nothing short of amazing every step of the way.

He recently had his teeth cleaned, and as always, the entire experience was excellent. The staff is incredibly friendly, welcoming, and attentive—they truly make both pets and owners feel comfortable from the moment you walk in. The facility is always spotless and well-maintained, which gives us great peace of mind.

What really sets them apart is the genuine care they show for Gentry. It’s clear that they treat him like one of their own, and that means everything to us. We trust them completely with his health and couldn’t ask for a better veterinary team.

Highly recommend Oak Forest Veterinary Hospital to anyone looking for compassionate, high-quality care for their pets!

Great experience at Oak Forest Veterinary Hospital!
Dr. Moore and Dr. Crocker are both very caring, knowledgeable, and take the time to explain everything clearly.
The staff is friendly, and the whole team makes you feel confident your pet is in good hands.
Highly recommend!
Lab technicians and front desk were very kind and helpful, even carried my dog out to the car for me!@
My puppy was so happy to get home. She said she had a wonderful time at the vet, and she did not mind getting her shots, and everybody treated her just wonderfully.
Wait time can be long past appointment time

Jackson, our cat has had. great care with his hydro therapy wound care postop ..Manuel is so gentle and professional with him and takes time to explain and go over details..we do so appreciate his caring and  thank him so, so much..
And a shout out to the receptionists..who man the front desk, they always present a professional, courteous,  and prompt response to find answers to questions/ concerns..  Their ph etiquette is so quick and with a pleasant voice ...its refreshing and nice...

I have been using Oak Forest Veterinary Hospital since 1994.  Dr. Moore and her team are fabulous.  They are professional and caring with all of their clients.  I will always be a loyal customer.  Natalie is a great ambassador that takes care of all your needs at the desk.  You should be welcome to take your pets there for care.
Thank you.
Oak Forest Veterinary Hospital has such a helpful & friendly staff. They are very good about staying on schedule, so the wait is no bad, which helps with my busy schedule.
Hi.my experiences  have always been great ..the staff ,veterinarian  docs and helpers are always been great the vet always explains  every detail  about my pets if I could give more stars I would.
They are amazing i have been there with them for years and they are always amazing and caring with my pets
Real people who really care.

All 3 of our dogs get all their medical care and boarding at Oak Forest Veterinary Hospital. The whole team, from reception to the vets, give excellent care and attention to all our pups. I can tell how good they are with my dogs by the way each dog reacts when we arrive.

Oak Forrest veterinary clinic has been our pets health care provider for 15 years our various Boxers has received vaccinations, routine, healthcare, laboratory services, ultrasound, x-rays, and surgery, dental care as well as end of life care. They have also assisted in obtaining cremation service.

Communication Sensehas always been excellent, the clerical and medical staff are consistent in providing Clear, Timely,concise and compassionate communication and care. I highly recommend that you turn your pets healthcare over to to Oak Forest Veterinary Clinic. Your pet will get the best of healthcare. You will be pleased by the service.
Always great doctors and staff. My doggies and family love this place.
Reasonable pricing, very kind team. I'd 100% come back
Fantastic Staff.
Dr. Moore and her staff are wonderful caregivers who really take the time with your pet.  They are very knowledgeable and thorough in explaining the details of your visit.

Thoroughly enjoyed our visit. Felt comprehensive and very reasonably priced. Only downside is they do not partner with chewy but do have a pharmacy they work with that has comparable prices and allows for a seamless rx process.

Oak Forest Veterinary Hospital is a trusted, well established, veterinary Hospital that's been in the neighborhood for decades.
Great friendly staff.

They’re amazing! I called and they fit me in on the same day. They were attentive to my concerns and listened when I explained what I needed. They were willing to work with me and were knowledgeable about what my pet needed. Dr. Stephanie …
extremely difficult to book an appointment with.
My pets have seen numerous doctors and they have all been wonderful. The techs are awesome and the front desk staff are always welcoming.
Thank you.

If you bring in your animal with blankets or towels, they WILL STEAL THEM. Someone was asking about their stolen blanket while I waited and the front desk didn't sound like they took him seriously. I ignored the warning signs and carelessly let them steal a towel from me. Please don't ignore this warning sign like I did!

I don’t have an easy dog, and this is a FANTASTIC vet. He’s over 100 pounds, gets EXTREMELY nervous at the vet (needs a muzzle), and is reactive to other dogs. A trifecta! The entire staff has been so incredibly caring and accommodating of …

Cannot say enough good things
Our Veterinarian Dr. Stephanie Cerovsky addressed our concerns very thoroughly and shared critical knowledge with …
Awesome staff. They take care of our babies very well.

Love OFVH. The vet is not my pet's favorite place to go but Dr Crocker and the staff are so compassionate with her.  They always address the issues we have and Dr Crocker explains everything perfectly.

I've been going to Oak Forest for a very long time and they have never  ever let me down.   Every person there will help in anyway they can and I love them for it.  I wouldn't even think of going anywhere else.

I had been bringing my cat here for over 10 years and at that time never really had any issues. This is a very popular clinic. Lots of people come here. I’ve always had good service until fairly recently. I will be going to another clinic …

My baby girl Jasper had officially hit her double digits and I knew she was due for a senior check up. I hadn’t found a vet yet in the area that I trusted but I decided to give this place a try. I was blown away by the level of care and …

I will no longer be using your establishment for medical care for my dog I paid $700 for my dog to have mass removed from his nose they offered to take blood same day to ensure he was healthy for surgery only to get a call day of his …

I recently lost my beloved cat, DJ (May 12, 2006 - February 5, 2025) after 18-1/2 wonderful years.   I really appreciate Dr. Moore, Dr. Lane and the staff of the exceptional care they have provided during DJ's life.  Their compassion, kindness, professionalism and support will never be forgotten.
Thank you.

Love this place! I’ve been bringing my dog here since he was a puppy and everything is always smooth. My dog is a bit dog reactive and they have a separate space in the lobby for dogs who are unsure of the environment. On top of that he …
Was looking for a new vet for my pets, first time here, loved the ambiance and cleanliness. Staff is friendly and Dr Lane is very knowledgeable. Will definitely bring my babies here from now on. 💗 …

I believe this will be my second review. Back in July of 2022, I had to put down my Max, but at the ER. I called Oak Forest to speak with Dr. Crocker, since Max had been under her care, and she called when she got in. She listened to me, as …
